posts.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Astra
posts.summary: OpenAI released GPT-6 Astra as a frontier computer-use model and the first to hit its Critical cybersecurity threshold. Greg Brockman framed the launch as the start of the AGI era; rollout starts with Daybreak enterprise, then Plus/Pro/Business/Enterprise and the API.

posts.title: Nvidia confirms $12.9B Hugging Face buy
posts.summary: Nvidia confirmed it will acquire Hugging Face for $12.93 billion. Jensen Huang said the hub stays multi-vendor and open — Nvidia compute won’t be required.

posts.title: VentureBeat: Welcome to the AGI era — Astra
posts.summary: VB covers Astra with Brockman’s AGI-era line: autonomous computer use across browsers/desktop, Critical cyber, Daybreak-first access.

posts.title: Meta Muse Spark 1.3 — best config still gated
posts.summary: Muse Spark 1.3 ships big coding/agent gains; strongest max-reasoning config still in safety testing. API stays $1.25/$4.25 per MTok.

posts.title: Microsoft MAI-Transcribe-2 at $0.10/hour
posts.summary: MAI-Transcribe-2 at 10¢/hour with 60 languages, diarization, timestamps — undercuts OpenAI, Google, ElevenLabs.

posts.title: Accel eyes $1B Thinking Machines round at $40B
posts.summary: Accel reportedly in talks to lead a $1B raise for Mira Murati’s Thinking Machines at ≥$40B valuation.

posts.title: Crusoe raises $3B at $30B valuation
posts.summary: AI data-center builder Crusoe reportedly raised $3B at $30B; customers include Meta, Microsoft, OpenAI.

posts.title: Altman apologizes for messy Astra rollout
posts.summary: Sam Altman apologized for a messy GPT-6 Astra rollout that left many paying users locked out; hoped weekend access, no firm promise.

posts.title: Google Photos lands in Gemini Spark
posts.summary: Google Photos rolling into Gemini Spark for AI Pro/Ultra in the US — search, organize, curate via the agent.

posts.title: Abliteration.ai sells de-guardrailed models
posts.summary: Abliteration.ai commercializes stripping open-weight refusals; hosts modified models including GLM-5.3 via API/browser.

posts.title: Meta discounts Muse Spark for training data
posts.summary: Muse Spark contributor tier ~95% off ($0.10/$0.20) if you share prompts/outputs; standard stays $1.25/$4.25.

posts.title: Nvidia buys Hugging Face — Verge angle
posts.summary: The Verge on Nvidia’s $12.93B Hugging Face deal; hub’s last official valuation was $4.5B in 2023.

posts.title: LLaDA-Image — 6B open image generator
posts.summary: Ant Group’s inclusionAI released LLaDA-Image, a 6B open-weight gen/edit model plus 4-step Turbo. Qwen-Image-Bench ~53.5 EN / ~53.4 ZH.

posts.title: K2 Horizon — six fully open models to 375B
posts.summary: IFM released six Apache-2.0 models (0.9B–375B) with weights, training code, data mixtures, and eval logs.

posts.title: Astra hits 99.9% ARC-AGI-3 with harness
posts.summary: ARC Prize: Astra 62.7% standard harness (~$26k) vs 99.9% Provider Adapter harness (~$19k) on ARC-AGI-3 Semi-Private.

posts.title: Claude Code 2.1.260 — live /diff panel
posts.summary: Claude Code adds /diff for uncommitted changes beside chat, plus a fix for permission paths with parentheses.

posts.title: GPT-6 Astra computer-use model rolls out
posts.summary: AI/TLDR: Astra works browsers/spreadsheets/desktop; 72.6% offline OSWorld 2.0 subset; API $10/$50 per MTok.

posts.title: DeepSeek plans 160k Huawei chips for Mongolia DC
posts.summary: DeepSeek plans ≥160,000 Huawei AI chips at an Inner Mongolia data center amid Nvidia export curbs. (Prismix)

posts.title: ByteDance secures ~$30B loan for AI spend
posts.summary: ByteDance borrowing ~$30B — its biggest loan and among Asia’s largest dollar deals this year — for AI infrastructure. (Prismix)

posts.title: Nvidia eyes $2.5B into Thinking Machines Lab
posts.summary: Thinking Machines in talks for $5–6B at ≥$40B; Accel leading, Nvidia expected ~$2.5B. (Prismix / The Information)
